race.comment: They'll go like the clappers in this. JUST AWESOME (2) wasn't too far away in town when resuming and will have taken a lot of benefit from that hit-out. Gets a bunch of weight relief with the 3kg claim and looks the runner in this line-up with the most upside. This is easier and rates the testing material. DONWON (3) has placed over this track and trip and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. In the mix on best figures. PRINCESS CRUIZER (4) is a four-time winner around this circuit, draws favourably in gate two and is another to get some weight off. Ticks a few boxes for a race like this. GUNROOM (1) will be ready to peak now third run back and may trouble the judge with luck in running. YES YES BOSS (11) best of the rest.
